summary: This note is a short Wikipedia-style entry about Prince Anwer Ali, son of Emperor Muhammad Shah. It describes how, after Muhammad Shah was attacked and deposed by Ahmad Shah Abdali in 1748, the roughly 17-and-a-half-year-old prince escaped to his grand aunt Princess Jahanarra and hid in a bear-infested place in Arrah, Bihar. The note adds that he later named this place Bhaluhipur.
one_line: Prince Anwer Ali, son of Emperor Muhammad Shah, escaped to Arrah, Bihar after the 1748 deposition and later named his hiding place Bhaluhipur.
key_facts: Prince Anwer Ali was the son of Emperor Muhammad Shah.
Muhammad Shah was attacked and deposed by Ahmad Shah Abdali in 1748.
In 1748, Prince Anwer Ali was about 17 and a half years old.
After the deposition, Prince Anwer Ali escaped to his grand aunt Princess Jahanarra.
Prince Anwer Ali hid in a place in Arrah, Bihar.
The hiding place in Arrah, Bihar was infested with bears.
Prince Anwer Ali later named the place Bhaluhipur.
